description: Reads the text of an image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 4 MB) with Llama 3.2 11B Vision on Workers AI. Send an https url or base64 image, and optionally a language hint. Returns the full text with its line breaks, the lines, a language guess and the model that answered. An image with no readable text is a 422 and is not charged. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

image.description: Alternative: the image as base64, up to 4 MB

language.description: Optional hint, e.g. English or German
